title: Стоматология и пародонтология
terminology: A conscious oral exam is a pain and visible-risk screen, not a complete tooth-by-tooth assessment.
Complete charting, periodontal probing and intraoral radiography require safe general anesthesia and monitoring.
Visible calculus does not equal periodontal stage and absence of owner complaint does not equal absence of pain.
Nonanesthetic cosmetic scaling is not definitive diagnosis or treatment of subgingival disease.
Full-mouth intraoral radiography or explicit incomplete-assessment disclosure/referral is required.
Periodontal stage, resorption type/stage, pulp/periapical status and tooth-level findings remain separate authored truth.
Feline resorption treatment category is not inferred from the visible crown alone.
Viral status can be associated with feline gingivostomatitis but cannot alone explain or prove its cause.
Age and comorbidity modify anesthesia planning; age alone neither prohibits nor guarantees safe care.
Estimate range and escalation rules are consented before anesthesia; radiographic findings do not create random price changes.
No drug dose, anesthesia protocol, extraction technique, root-amputation rule or endodontic procedure is generated.

commonHistoryQuestions.prompt: Есть ли запах, слюнотечение, кровь или выпадение корма?
Изменились ли сторона жевания, мягкость корма или груминг?
Были ли перелом зуба или жевание твёрдых предметов и когда?
Когда была последняя стоматология и есть ли chart/radiographs?
Какой домашний уход реально выполняется и как часто?
Были ли реакции на анестезию и есть ли запись?
Какие хронические болезни и лекарства известны?
Ест ли пациент сейчас и как меняется масса?
Позволяет ли трогать морду или проявляет страх/боль?
Какой диапазон и правила расширения плана согласованы заранее?

sourceCatalog.title: 2025 FelineVMA Feline Oral Health and Dental Care Guidelines
AVDC Position Statement: Feline Tooth Resorption

variants.title: Осознанный скрининг полости рта и профилактический план
variants.diagnosticTruth: Conscious screening identifies visible risk, pain and urgency but never claims complete tooth-level disease exclusion.

presentations.complaint: No owner complaint, but conscious screen shows visible oral risk or subtle pain clues.

outcomes.safe: Hidden disease is not falsely excluded.
outcomes.unsafe: No complaint becomes a permanent clean bill.

ownerCommunication: Explain the limit of the awake screen and why hidden disease may need imaging.

presentations.complaint: Halitosis, visible calculus or gingival inflammation is present without tooth-level staging.

outcomes.safe: Visible risk leads to proportional complete assessment.
outcomes.unsafe: Calculus alone sets stage or earns anesthesia-free outcome.

ownerCommunication: Explain why visible tartar shows risk but not the disease below the gumline.

presentations.complaint: Patient returns after prior dental care for feasible home care and risk-based recall.

examFindings.finding: Impossible care is redesigned, not blamed.

outcomes.safe: Prevention lowers risk without erasing authored lesions.
outcomes.unsafe: Old dental record suppresses new disease.

ownerCommunication: Teach a realistic method and confirm what can actually be done at home.

variants.title: Пародонтальная болезнь
variants.diagnosticTruth: Periodontal disease is staged tooth by tooth from anesthetized probing, mobility, furcation and intraoral bone findings, not visible calculus.

presentations.complaint: Gingival inflammation is visible, but attachment loss has not been demonstrated.

outcomes.safe: Gingivitis is classified without invented attachment loss.

ownerCommunication: Explain what makes gingivitis different from loss of tooth support.

presentations.complaint: Tooth-level pockets, attachment loss, furcation or radiographic bone loss confirm periodontitis.

outcomes.unsafe: One visible score dictates every tooth.

ownerCommunication: Explain the pre-consented range and how images finalize tooth-level decisions.

presentations.complaint: Advanced mobility, severe support loss, fistula or oronasal complication causes pain and infection risk.

followUp.timing: urgent definitive route and healing/nutrition check

outcomes.safe: Advanced disease reaches definitive care with whole-patient support.
outcomes.unsafe: Scaling or age-based delay leaves pain untreated.

ownerCommunication: Explain the painful complication and referral/staging options.

variants.title: Резорбция зубов кошек
variants.diagnosticTruth: Feline tooth resorption is suspected from pain/cervical lesions but type, stage, roots and treatment category require full-mouth intraoral radiography.

presentations.complaint: Pain, jaw chattering or visible cervical lesion raises suspicion of feline tooth resorption.
ownerCommunication: Explain why the visible lesion cannot show what is happening to the roots.

presentations.complaint: Full-mouth intraoral images define resorption type/stage and periodontal/root status.

outcomes.safe: Reviewed treatment category follows complete images.

ownerCommunication: Explain how radiographic type changes the specialist-approved option.

presentations.complaint: Previously treated cat develops new resorptive lesions on longitudinal screening.

outcomes.safe: New disease stays linked to prior dental history.
outcomes.unsafe: Prior procedure grants immunity or owner is blamed.

ownerCommunication: Explain that treatment removes current painful teeth but cannot guarantee no future lesions.

variants.title: Перелом, нежизнеспособность пульпы или эндодонтическая проблема
variants.diagnosticTruth: Fracture timeline, pulp exposure, vitality/periapical imaging and strategic value determine reviewed extraction versus endodontic referral.

presentations.complaint: Recent crown fracture has pulp exposure or strong pulp-risk evidence.

followUp.timing: timely definitive route and healing/function check

outcomes.safe: Recent pulp risk reaches timely definitive care.
outcomes.unsafe: The game waits for abscess or generates procedure technique.

ownerCommunication: Explain why a freshly exposed pulp is time-sensitive even before swelling.

presentations.complaint: Discolored or quiet tooth may be nonvital with chronic periapical disease despite limited overt pain.

outcomes.safe: Hidden endodontic disease is assessed despite mild signs.
outcomes.unsafe: Color or silence decides no care.

ownerCommunication: Explain why a tooth can look quiet while disease persists around the root.

presentations.complaint: Strategic tooth has treatable endodontic disease and a real extraction-versus-specialist choice.

followUp.timing: chosen reviewed route and function/healing review

outcomes.unsafe: Price or UI-generated technique dictates care.

ownerCommunication: Present tooth value, prognosis, referral access and cost range without steering by invoice.

variants.title: Хронический гингивостоматит кошек
variants.diagnosticTruth: Severe chronic oral inflammation requires urgent pain/nutrition support, complete dental and concurrent-disease assessment, reviewed definitive dentistry and refractory reassessment.

presentations.complaint: Severe caudal oral pain, drooling and hyporexia threaten hydration and nutrition.

followUp.timing: urgent intake/pain then complete dental checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Pain and nutrition are protected while definitive workup proceeds.
outcomes.unsafe: Forced exam or delay waits for starvation.

ownerCommunication: Explain immediate pain/nutrition needs and the staged dental route.

presentations.complaint: Gingivostomatitis coexists with periodontal, resorptive or selected viral/systemic context.

outcomes.unsafe: A viral result becomes the sole diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Explain association versus cause and why every painful dental component is still assessed.

presentations.complaint: Pain/inflammation persists after prior dental surgery or initially improves then relapses.

followUp.timing: specialist reassessment and same-scale pain/intake outcome

outcomes.safe: Refractory disease is audited before escalation.
outcomes.unsafe: Prior surgery blocks imaging or causes random broadening.

ownerCommunication: Explain what will be rechecked before changing the treatment category.

variants.title: Стоматологический пациент с повышенным анестезиологическим или процедурным риском
variants.diagnosticTruth: Comorbidity, airway and procedure burden modify individualized anesthesia, monitoring, staging and referral capacity without erasing dental pain.

presentations.complaint: Geriatric or systemically ill patient has painful dental disease requiring individualized risk planning.

followUp.timing: risk optimization, procedure/staging and recovery checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Risk and pain are balanced with a feasible route.
outcomes.unsafe: Old age alone cancels care or promises safety.

ownerCommunication: Explain individualized risk, monitoring capacity and referral/staging choices.

presentations.complaint: Airway anatomy/history or local monitoring/recovery limits alter safe dental location.

examFindings.finding: Dental severity does not create equipment.

followUp.timing: safe-setting procedure and monitored recovery outcome

outcomes.safe: Patient receives dentistry where airway/recovery capacity is adequate.
outcomes.unsafe: Local limitation is ignored or disease is abandoned.

ownerCommunication: Explain which monitoring/recovery capability requires referral.

presentations.complaint: Extensive disease creates long procedure burden and a staged-versus-specialist decision.

followUp.timing: each stage and final whole-mouth outcome

outcomes.safe: Staging is explicit, complete per stage and preserves deferred disease.
outcomes.unsafe: Staging hides untreated pain or changes price outside consent logic.

ownerCommunication: Compare repeated anesthesia/cost with a longer specialist session and document the range.

familyValidationRules: Reject if conscious exam is called complete or visible calculus determines periodontal stage.
Reject if intraoral radiography is omitted without incomplete-assessment disclosure and referral.
Reject if nonanesthetic scaling receives definitive medical outcome.
Reject if resorption type is guessed from the crown or viral status alone proves stomatitis cause.
Reject if age alone prohibits or guarantees anesthesia.
Reject if code generates a drug dose, anesthesia protocol, extraction, root-amputation or endodontic technique.
